rows.en: <operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>The goal this time is to capture <move(1,7,4)>the enemy <color(5)>defense bases<ce()><marker(27,7,2,0)>, <marker(27,12,4,0)>every <marker(27,7,6,0)>last <marker(27,2,4,0)>one.<move(2,7,4)><picture(54,30,7,0)><refer(30,7,7,2)>
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>The <color(5)>defense bases<ce()> are shown by the markers on your radar.
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>Defeat the <color(5)>enemy units<ce()> posted around one, and the <color(6)>base capture<ce()> succeeds.

<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>The enemy's <marker(20,14,1,0)><marker(20,12,1,0)>exact <marker(20,2,0,0)><marker(20,0,1,0)>force makeup<marker(20,11,7,0)><marker(20,13,7,0)> is unknown,<marker(20,10,12,0)><marker(20,12,10,0)><marker(20,10,10,0)> but there seem to be enemies not confirmed until now.
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>They look tougher than the enemies so far, so please take great care.
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>On the radar, <color(6)>units with high combat ability<ce()> are shown in <color(6)>purple<ce()>. Please check carefully.
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>Also, a <book(9)>Federation<endbook()> <color(4)>allied unit<ce()><marker(5,1,11,0)> will <marker(5,4,13,0)>take part in this operation.

<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)><move(1,2,13)>The <color(4)>Nadesico<ce()><marker(3,2,13,0)> will be at the front too, so escort duty is left to them,<move(2,2,13)><picture(51,2,14,0)><refer(2,14,2,13)> but please give support if things turn bad.
<delpic(2,7,1)><enemylist()><operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>Well then, everyone, I am counting on you.

uncertainties.issue: "them" = the Federation allied unit of slot 26 (karera); "if things turn bad" = ressei ni natta toki, source does not say whose disadvantage (allies or Nadesico).
Four markers spread over ", every last one" to mimic the source pacing; marker placement between words is a guess at timing.

meaning_fixes.reason: Command position: in the source <move(1,7,4)> sits directly before "teki no" (the enemy), after the topic "the goal this time is"; the draft fired it two words early, before "to capture". Visible text unchanged.

checked_decisions: Slot 27 ruling: "them" = the Federation allied unit of slot 26 (source "karera"), correct; "if things turn bad" correctly keeps the party unstated as in the source.
Slot 20 ruling: marker spread over ", every last one" is fine; only the <move> was shifted (see meaning_fixes).
Slot 22: "capture" consistent with meeting_briefing_015 "Capture all target bases".
remaining_uncertainties: Slot 20: <move(1,7,4)> moved two words later to sit before "the enemy"; the on-screen timing effect is not verifiable without a build.
Slot 27: whose disadvantage "ressei" refers to is not stated in the source; draft keeps it open.
